question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.**

Bite the bullet

options.text: Decide to do something that is difficult

solution:
The correct answer is: **Decide to do something that is difficult.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**Bite the bullet**" is an idiom that means to make a difficult decision or to endure a painful or unpleasant situation. (कोई कठिन निर्णय लेना या किसी दर्दनाक या अप्रिय स्थिति को सहना)
 
• The phrase originated from the practice of giving a wounded soldier a bullet to bite down on during surgery before the invention of anaesthesia.
 
• The idiom is often used in situations where one has to face the consequences of their actions or decisions.
 
 
• **Example**: *Despite the fear of losing his job, John decided to bite the bullet and speak up against the unethical practices at his workplace.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.
